newsitem.title: FRANCE: CFDT union boss not hostile to Fr Telecom sale.
newsitem.headline: CFDT union boss not hostile to Fr Telecom sale.

text.p: Nicole Notat, the moderate leader of France's traditionally Socialist-leaning CFDT trade union, said on Tuesday she was not hostile to an opening up of France Telecom capital to private investors as long as the state guaranteed a "quality public service".

"An opening up of the capital, which does not by the way amount to a privatisation to the tune of 100 percent since there is a continued state presence, does not seem incompatible to me as long as the state ensures a genuine mission of a quality public service," she said on Europe 1 radio.

Plans by the outgoing centre-right government to sell a minority stake in France Telecom are in doubt after the election and pending formation of a new government by the Socialist party. It has said it will "consult" France Telecom staff before deciding what to do with the dossier.
